name: Fernando Rodriguez Garcia
headline: CTO @ Adhara  |  Backend Expert (Go / Java / JS)  |  Blockchain & AI
summary: Engineering leader with 15+ years building scalable distributed systems, blockchain platforms, and AI-driven products in fintech and regulated markets. CTO at Adhara, co-owning technology vision and execution for digital money and settlement infrastructure for central banks and financial institutions, while driving the company's AI strategy from experimentation to production.

roles.title: CTO
bullets: Co-own company-wide technology strategy and lead the engineering organization, from platform architecture and product engineering to delivery in highly regulated financial environments.
Drive Adhara's AI strategy: embedding AI across engineering and shipping AI-enabled capabilities from experimentation to production-grade systems.
Lead the modernization of the core platform for scalable, resilient, and secure settlement and tokenized money infrastructure; stay hands-on in architecture, Go backends, and Ethereum/DLT design.

Own the technical narrative with customers, partners, and regulators (due diligence, security posture, architecture) and partner with the CEO and business leadership to align technology investment with strategy.

roles.title: Principal Engineer (prev. Technical Lead)
bullets: Architected next-generation Ethereum and deposit token platforms enabling real-time, multi-currency settlement and cross-border payments for regulated financial markets.
Led cross-functional engineering teams across Spain and South Africa, ensuring scalability, resilience, and security of production-grade DLT software.

roles.title: Co-founder & CTO
bullets: Architected scalable backend infrastructure and Android/iOS API layer for a mobile-first events platform, enabling seamless native integrations.
Designed an asynchronous job distribution system in Java and RabbitMQ, dynamically scaling workers based on real-time load.

roles.title: Head of Backend Development
bullets: Led backend engineering integrating cloud infrastructure with Salesforce to automate CI/CD pipelines and release management for enterprise clients.
Mentored a multidisciplinary backend team; drove adoption of automated testing, significantly reducing deployment times and increasing release frequency.

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Developed PSD2-compliant open banking API platform for BBVA and Bankinter, enabling secure third-party integrations and regulatory compliance.

skills.items: Ethereum, Smart Contracts, DLT, Digital Tokens, Deposit Tokens
REST APIs, Distributed Systems, RabbitMQ, Spring, Microservices, Docker

education.degree: Ingeniero Informático Superior (M.Eng. equivalent), Computer Engineering
